comments.why: Magic Whiteboard's Dragons' Den pitch for reusable sticky sheets
comments.text: Magic Whiteboard is pretty cool too: [LINK] It's basically a roll of big white sheets that stick to walls without adhesive. They're also erasable/reusable. Took off after appearing on Dragon's Den (a TV show where entrepreneurs pitch their ideas to investors): [VIDEO]
